question: A student tracked assignment completion. Starting with 46 problems, morning work completed 18 (28 remaining). Mid-morning completion removed 2 more (26 remaining). Afternoon additions added 75 (101). Late additions brought 13 more (114). For final exam practice, this multiplied by 3. What was the exam practice load?

A library started with 179 volumes. Morning removals took 49 (130 volumes). Afternoon recategorization moved 43 (87 volumes). New acquisitions added 61 (148 volumes). Evening processing added 20 (168 volumes). Final batch additions added 58 volumes. A dozen is a set of 12 items. How many volumes total?

David and Marcus tracked progress. Starting with 120 units, additions added 35 (155 units). Growth multiplied by 4 (620 units). Setback removed 166 (454 units). Recovery bonus added 69 (523 units). Year-end projection multiplied by 6. Sarah had 140 units baseline. What was the projection?

Two project leads compared milestones. Starting with 180 hours, doubling multiplied by 2 (360 hours). Scope additions added 68 (428 hours). Scope reductions removed 255 (173 hours). Monthly expansion multiplied by 3 (519 hours). Bonus added 71. Converting to weekly amounts, this represented about 84 hours weekly. What was the total?

A business tracked morning, afternoon, and evening. Starting with 81 metrics, morning impact removed 80 (1 unit). Recovery added 57 (58 units). Afternoon improvement added 35 (93 units). Late afternoon loss removed 77 (16 units). Evening adjustment removed 9 units. How many final units?

Two analysts tracked morning, afternoon, and evening metrics. Starting with 125 data points, morning purge removed 119 (6 points). First consolidation divided by 2 (3 points). Afternoon additions added 55 (58 points). Late reductions removed 28 (30 points). Final aggregation divided by 3. What was the aggregated result?

James and David managed items. Starting with 104 items, receiving added 24 (128 items). Damage removal removed 9 (119 items). Inventory adjustment removed 78 (41 items). Multiplication factor applied 8 times (328 items). Final distribution removed 210 items. Converting to dozens, this represented 9 dozen. What was final?

Marcus and Elena compared totals. Starting with 167 points, boost added 28 (195 points). Correction subtracted 184 (11 points). Recovery added 66 (77 points). Multiplier applied 3 times (231 points). Championship multiplier applied 9 times. Converting to sets of 10, this represented 207.9. What was final?

A schedule tracked morning, afternoon, and evening with unit conversion. Starting with 120 minutes, first division by 3 (40 minutes). Second division by 2 (20 minutes). Morning meetings removed 8 (12 minutes). Afternoon meetings removed 3 more minutes. Converting to seconds, this represented 540 seconds. How many minutes final?

David and Elena tracked progress morning, afternoon, and evening. Starting with 106 units, growth added 70 (176 units). Adjustment removed 156 (20 units). Scaling multiplied by 5 (100 units). Final bonus added 36 units. Marcus had 95 units on his path. How many final units?

Marco started his school fundraiser with 119 dollars. In the morning, three student groups brought in 65, 61, and 42 dollars respectively. By afternoon, he had collected enough to multiply his total by 8 as a bank matched the funds. He then divided the matched amount into 4 equal parts for different school programs. What was the final amount in each part?

Emma had collected 222 trading cards over the summer. She doubled her collection by trading with friends. Then she gave away 264 cards at school, lost 24 cards at the park, and sold 111 cards online. Tracking her remaining collection throughout this journey, how many cards did Emma have at the end?

In the morning, a farmer had 62 chickens. By afternoon, 19 chickens had wandered off. Then 16 more were moved to another pen. The remaining flock was multiplied by 6 for a breeding program count, then multiplied by 9 for insurance purposes. Finally, 665 chickens were subtracted from the record (a correction for a counting error). What was the final number on the inventory?

A coffee shop served 81 customers in the morning. In the afternoon, 14 more customers arrived, and later 39 additional patrons came for evening service. The manager then grouped them by 6 for a study on peak hours. This group count was divided by 4 for scheduling purposes. Finally, 92 customers were subtracted from the projection (an adjustment for cancellations). What was the final customer projection?

Maya started her study session with 216 flashcards. She removed 192 to focus on difficult topics. By afternoon, 20 were added back, and another 6 were included from a friend. Then she lost 41 cards on the way home. Marcus had accumulated just a few, but how many flashcards did Maya have remaining?

A printer received 184 pages of orders. The order count was multiplied by 5 for a rush job. These were then divided by 4 to determine batch sizes. Each batch was tripled for reprinting purposes. Then everything was multiplied by 7 for archival records. Additionally, 33 pages were damaged (not used in calculations). How many archival pages were recorded?

During a fundraiser, the group had 113 participants. Early on, 69 left due to weather. Then 18 returned when it cleared. By afternoon, 30 more left to catch trains. Later, 14 additional participants left early. However, 78 new volunteers arrived to help. Finally, 73 were subtracted from the final count for administrative purposes. Additionally, a competing group had collected 55 funds (not relevant). What was the final participant count?

Lisa and Tom are comparing their savings. Lisa had 132 dollars and received 56 more from babysitting. She earned another 56 from tutoring, and her grandmother gave her 36 dollars. From this total, she spent 107 dollars on equipment. Throughout these changes, how many dollars does Lisa have?

A company processed 227 orders. By the end of the day, 218 had been shipped. They then received 78 new orders. This amount was tripled for a weekly projection. After review, 210 orders were subtracted due to cancellations. Then 14 were added as rush orders. The final count was multiplied by 4 for inventory purposes. Additionally, 35 orders were pending (not included). How many orders were in final inventory?

Two colleagues, Ben and Kate, split workload. Ben started with 24 tasks. He divided them in half to share equally. He then multiplied his share by 5. He added 11 more tasks. Then 48 were removed from his list. He doubled his remaining tasks by 9 for a projected month. Finally, he added 58 backup tasks. In hours per task (time conversion), what was Ben's final task total?

A library started with 13 books on the new shelf. Morning brought 4 donations, afternoon brought 51, and evening brought 52 more. Finally, 29 books arrived from another branch. Two other shelves had about 76 books each (not counted here). How many books did the shelf end up with?

Two investors, Marcus and Sarah, track their portfolios. Marcus started with 126 dollars. He earned 29 more through dividends. He then doubled his account through a promotion. All of this was multiplied by 8 through reinvestment. Then 1774 dollars were subtracted due to market losses. How many dollars does Marcus have in his final portfolio?

Two farmers, Ben and Lisa, track livestock. Ben has 170 cattle. He doubled his herd through breeding. Then he multiplied by 6 more. He added 72 from a purchase. This total was multiplied by 5. Then multiplied by 3 more for a census count. By comparison with Lisa's smaller herd, what was Ben's final count?

A bakery baked 18 loaves of bread in the morning. During the day, they multiplied by 6 for a bulk order. Then multiplied by 4 for an afternoon shift. Then multiplied by 2 for an evening batch. They added 76 loaves from a previous day's unsold inventory. How many loaves total did the bakery have?

A warehouse had 79 boxes. It removed 28 for immediate shipment. Then added 52 from a new delivery. The collection was multiplied by 9 for a storage calculation. This was divided by 3 for shelf allocation. Then multiplied by 5 again for a larger shipment plan. Finally, 39 more boxes arrived. What was the final box count?
